tools_problematic.problem: Cannot resolve subst drives; reports 'unavailable' with misleading hint about Developer Mode/MAX_PATH when the real issue is subst drive incompatibility with Windows package registration
tools_problematic.evidence: Turns 14-20 in parity phase: repeated 'error 0x80070003: Opening file from location: AppxManifest.xml' with 'Usually Developer Mode off... not a migration defect'

tools_problematic.problem: Fails silently on subst drives without diagnosing the root cause
tools_problematic.evidence: winapp run returned 0x80070003 repeatedly from turn 9 through turn 48 regardless of path shortening attempts

tool_limitations.limitation: Does not detect subst/virtual drives and warn the user that package registration requires real filesystem paths
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a check: if the resolved layout path starts with a subst drive letter, resolve to the real path via (Get-Item $path).Target or subst output, and warn the agent

tool_limitations.limitation: Source path resolution assumed relative location under the trial directory (uwp-samples-standalone subfolder), which didn't exist; agent had to manually locate the correct path at B:\agent-benchmark\uwp-samples-standalone
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: The prompt hint '../../../uwp-samples-standalone' should resolve relative to the working directory, or the script should search common known locations

special_apis.special_handling: MediaPlayerElement does not expose AutomationId through UIA. Must wrap in a Grid or Border with the AutomationId set on the wrapper to make it discoverable by UIA inspection tools.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Build prompt hinted at relative path '../../../uwp-samples-standalone' but the actual location was B:\agent-benchmark\uwp-samples-standalone (not under the trial directory)
errors_encountered.fix: Agent searched parent directories and found the correct path at turn 6-7

errors_encountered.error: 0x80070003: Opening file from location: AppxManifest.xml failed with error: The system cannot find the path specified
errors_encountered.root_cause: B: drive is a subst mapping to C:\ado\win-dev-skills-benchmark; Windows package registration (Add-AppxPackage/winapp run) cannot resolve subst drive letters
errors_encountered.fix: Agent changed OutputPath to C:\ado\w\o\ (real filesystem path) at turn 48-50

errors_encountered.error: App launched (PID 9404) but process died before capture
errors_encountered.root_cause: First app launch used dotnet run without --no-build which held the shell; by the time capture script ran, the app had already exited (likely lifecycle timeout or foreground loss)
errors_encountered.fix: Agent re-launched with dotnet run and captured immediately in subsequent attempt

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeated 0x80070003 package registration failure across ~40 turns despite trying different layout paths, output path shortcuts, and winapp invocation variants
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~40 turns (turns 9 through 50 in parity check phase)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: B: drive is a subst drive (B: => C:\ado\win-dev-skills-benchmark); Windows deployment service cannot resolve virtual/subst drives for package registration
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent eventually ran 'subst' command (turn 47), discovered B: was virtual, and switched OutputPath to a real C:\ path
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Test-AppLaunch.ps1 or the skill bootstrap should detect subst drives and auto-resolve to the real path, or the skill guidance should explicitly warn about subst/junction incompatibility with package registration

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App launched with PID 9404 but crashed/exited before capture script could connect via UIA
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: dotnet run launches the app detached but the app window may close quickly if not kept in foreground; the capture script ran in a separate shell and by then the app was gone
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent re-launched the app and ran capture immediately in the same flow
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Capture-AppScenarios.ps1 should accept a launch command and handle app lifecycle itself, or the skill should instruct the agent to use dotnet run --no-build in async mode and immediately capture

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Scenarios 2, 5, 6 failing parity because MediaPlayerElement AutomationId not visible in UIA tree
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~20 turns debugging UIA dumps, trying AutomationId approaches
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: MediaPlayerElement does not expose AutomationProperties.AutomationId through UIA; the control's automation peer doesn't surface the property
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Wrapped MediaPlayerElement in a Grid with the AutomationId on the Grid (turn 115)
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Parity check skill/documentation should note that MediaPlayerElement requires a wrapper element for AutomationId exposure, or Extract-UwpFeatureChecklist should not require mediaPlayerElement detection by AutomationId

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 failed with 'Source not found' because the relative path hint in the prompt didn't resolve
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Prompt said source was at '../../../uwp-samples-standalone/Samples/AdaptiveStreaming/cs' relative to app dir, but the actual location was B:\agent-benchmark\uwp-samples-standalone (not relative to trial dir)
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent searched parent directories with Get-ChildItem and Test-Path to locate the correct absolute path
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Prompt should provide the absolute path to UWP source, or Initialize-UwpMigration should search known locations automatically
